summary: Fast-mode review of roadmap 1.4 (calls.top_reason/calls.top_anchor, the ⊤-anchor taxonomy). reviewer + architect specialists in parallel (blast radius >3 files, 14 touched). Cross-runtime codex skipped (degraded all session). Both specialists independently converged on the same HIGH finding: Head_local's unresolved branch in arch_index.ml defaulted straight to Some "callback_param" without checking dropped_local n first, unlike every sibling branch in the same match — zero soundness risk since kind was already MAY_TOP either way, but a dropped_node edge would have been silently mislabeled. Fixed by adding the same guard used elsewhere. Also found: a NULL-blind test assertion (top_reason != 'dropped_node' evaluates to SQL NULL, not TRUE, so a silently-missing reason would pass undetected — the exact regression class this taxonomy exists to catch); four production sites folding a genuinely-computed function-value head into callback_param with no disclosure (fixed via documentation, both reviewers accepted this over adding new vocabulary); a documented top_anchor format (file:line:col) that did not match its actual format (file:line); the NULL-unless-MAY_TOP pairing invariant being documented but unenforced beyond vocabulary (fixed with a new CHECK constraint plus a loader-side pairing check and two new global-invariant tests); and three LOW findings (top_anchor keyed off top_reason=None rather than kind directly, an inconsistent Module_param display name at one production site, and test assertions not pinning kind='MAY_TOP' alongside top_reason). All fixed. Separately, mid-review a cross-session coordination message from peer session arch-index-96 (parallel work on feat/error-channels) surfaced a real schema-version collision (both sessions had independently claimed current_schema_version = "1.6"); renumbered this task's bump to 1.7 across arch_index_db.ml, docs/schema.md, and this brief, verified via grep no stray 1.6 references remained. Re-verified end-to-end: build clean, 111/111 tests, self-index golden regenerated (21 modules / 576 functions / 3994 calls, reflecting the display-name fix's small resolution delta), must_null_ceiling re-checked against the new count within existing headroom. Convergence gate: no violations.
